purpose: Define a provenance-aware coordinate frame from source cues and user constraints while keeping unsupported orientation or unit choices unresolved.
trigger: A geometry contract lacks a usable origin, axis orientation, handedness, or unit context needed to describe spatial relations consistently.

inputs.name: geometry_observations
inputs.description: Observed primitives, features, relations, and coordinate cues from visual or textual sources; each item retains observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance.

inputs.name: frame_constraints
inputs.description: Optional user input for origin, axes, handedness, or units, kept distinct from source observations and inferred orientation.

inputs.name: source_locators
inputs.type: optional source viewpoint and locator record
inputs.description: Locations of axis marks, datums, annotations, or other frame cues used to support the definition; missing cues remain unresolved.

preconditions: The geometry observation context identifies the features or cues that could anchor an origin or axis, with source locators when available.
Any user frame constraint is explicitly identified as user input and no missing orientation, handedness, or unit is replaced by a silent default.
The operation is limited to coordinate-frame description and does not modify geometry, reconcile dimensions, or prescribe construction operations.

outputs.name: coordinate_system
outputs.description: Origin, axes, handedness, unit context, and reference cues with explicit observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance for each component.

outputs.name: frame_assumptions
outputs.description: Assumptions used to complete the frame, each with rationale, source support, confidence, and unresolved alternatives where applicable.

outputs.name: unresolved_items
outputs.description: Missing or conflicting origin, axis, handedness, or unit cues retained as unresolved items with the smallest clarification needed.

outputs.name: frame_confidence
outputs.description: Confidence and rationale for each frame component, distinguishing direct observation, user input, inference, and unresolved uncertainty.

postconditions: Origin, axes, handedness, and unit context are each labeled observation, user, inference, or unresolved and retain supporting source cues when available.
The coordinate system is usable only when its required components are supported; conflicting or missing components remain unresolved rather than receiving defaults.
Frame assumptions and orientation decisions are traceable and do not change geometry, dimensional values, or construction order.
The output exposes confidence and clarification needs for the downstream geometry contract.

implementation.target_environment: Visual/text reasoning only; no SpaceClaim runtime or application control.
implementation.notes: No standalone implementation artifact is published; this candidate is a contract-bound reasoning boundary assembled from linked general reference guidance.

ambiguity_checks: No application geometry is selected; frame anchors are matched to semantic feature descriptions and source locators.
Audit origin, axes, handedness, units, and assumptions for observation, user, inference, or unresolved provenance before handoff.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because the operation does not create or modify geometry topology.

failure_modes.condition: The source and user constraints do not support a usable origin, axis orientation, handedness, or unit context.
failure_modes.detection: Check required frame components and supporting locators before accepting the coordinate system.
failure_modes.safe_state: Keep unsupported components unresolved and do not emit a ready geometry handoff.

failure_modes.condition: Observed cues and user constraints imply incompatible origins, axis directions, handedness, or units.
failure_modes.detection: Compare each cue and constraint with its provenance and record incompatible alternatives.
failure_modes.safe_state: Preserve the competing frames as unresolved and make no automatic orientation choice.

failure_modes.condition: A frame component or assumption cannot be labeled as observation, user, inference, or unresolved with adequate source context.
failure_modes.detection: Run a provenance completeness audit over the coordinate system and assumptions.
failure_modes.safe_state: Mark the affected component unresolved and withhold a ready handoff.

recovery.action: Add the smallest missing datum, axis cue, unit statement, or user constraint and rerun frame definition.
Request an explicit user choice or clarifying source evidence, then rerun from the original cues.
Restore source or user provenance for the affected component and rerun the completeness audit.

validation.method: Review the template against the geometry-understanding stage contract and linked general guidance.
validation.expected: The operation defines a frame description only; it does not reconcile dimensions, alter geometry, choose a construction order, or run an application.

validation.method: Inspect input/output declarations, postconditions, failure modes, and recovery for observation, user, inference, and unresolved paths.
validation.expected: Each frame component is traceable and unsupported or conflicting cues remain unresolved rather than receiving defaults.

validation.method: Review identifiers, wording, artifact links, and evidence states for case-specific names, private data, numeric examples, and unsupported runtime claims.
validation.expected: The template is reusable across source types and claims design intent only.

validation.method: Validate resolved, underdetermined, and deliberately inconsistent frame outputs with the bound host checker.
validation.expected: Resolved axes are finite, normalized, orthogonal, handedness-consistent, source-view mapped, and blocking frame gaps cannot be marked ready.

evidence_refs.notes: Public design-only review record for this exact candidate template version.

design_only.notes: Atomicity, provenance separation, case neutrality, and the no-runtime boundary were reviewed.

evidence_refs.notes: Host-only schema and neutral fixture check for this exact candidate version.

host_checked.notes: The bound host checker passed structural and deterministic frame invariants; it did not evaluate unseen-source frame interpretation accuracy.

spaceclaim_execution.notes: This operation does not launch or control SpaceClaim.

geometry_measurements.notes: No model is measured; the operation records source frame interpretation only.

visual_review.notes: This is source-frame reasoning, not final viewport or image acceptance.

evidence_level.notes: Evidence stops at design_only and host_checked; unseen-source frame-mapping accuracy and all application, measurement, persistence, visual-acceptance, and export layers remain unclaimed.
